name: dollar-untagged
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $$name'.*\\\'.*'$$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-tagged
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $re$name'.*\\\'.*'$re$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-case-sensitive
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $Tag$name'.*\\\'.*' $tag$ version$Tag$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-nested-tag
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $outer$name'.*\\\'.*' $inner$ 'version'$outer$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-overlap-close
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $tag$name'.*\\\'.*'$other$tag$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-unicode-tag
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $tég$name'.*\\\'.*'$tég$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-underscore-tag
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $a_2$name'.*\\\'.*'$a_2$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-version-only
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $$version$$ WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-tagged-version-only
sql: UPDATE items SET name = $v$version$v$ WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-quoted-type
sql: UPDATE items SET name = "name" $$name'.*\\\'.*'$$, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: dollar-read-only-write-text
sql: SELECT id FROM items WHERE name = $$UPDATE items SET name = 'not here'$$;

name: dollar-identifier-boundary
sql: UPDATE items SET name = v.name$tag$, version = version + 1 FROM (VALUES ('identifier')) AS v(name$tag$) WHERE items.id = 1;

name: dollar-quoted-identifier-boundary
sql: UPDATE items SET name = v."$tag$", version = version + 1 FROM (VALUES ('quoted')) AS v("$tag$") WHERE items.id = 1;
